answer.rationale: Use a guarded referral-incentive response among established SMB customers rather than matching the competitor with broad discounts. Memory 57 indicates qualified-revenue gains without measurable retention harm. Although memory 73 summarizes promotional pricing positively, recovered source exp_73 shows 30-day retention fell 12%, making discount-led acquisition inconsistent with sustainable long-term qualified revenue. A small test is appropriate because the referral evidence has not been source-verified this cycle and was not specifically generated under the current competitive conditions.
